presentation.summary: Manage fatigue-related performance risk during an extended night shift with changing workload.
presentation.situation: A night shift is running longer than planned after an equipment problem. Several workers have already completed demanding tasks.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A night shift is running longer than planned after an equipment problem. Several workers have already completed demanding tasks.

work_authorization_record.title: Extended-Shift Fatigue Review
work_authorization_record.summary: The night shift will run beyond its planned finish while a critical task is still outstanding.
details: Several crew members have already completed demanding work during the shift.
Extending the shift increases time awake and may reduce alertness, attention and decision quality.
The criticality of the remaining task should be considered together with hours worked, rest opportunity and available staffing.

control_verification_record.title: Individual Fatigue Fitness Record
control_verification_record.summary: The most experienced worker for the next task has been awake considerably longer than the rest of the crew.
details: Experience with the task does not remove the performance effects associated with extended wakefulness.
Fatigue risk is individual and can differ even when workers are on the same shift.
Task assignment should account for alertness, backup, supervision and whether the work can be delayed or redistributed.

condition_change_record.title: Workload Escalation Record
condition_change_record.summary: A second urgent task has arrived while the crew is already behind schedule on an extended night shift.
details: The new request increases workload and time pressure without increasing the crew's available recovery.
The original shift plan did not include two simultaneous urgent demands at this late stage.
Priorities, staffing and task deferral options need to be reconsidered against the crew's current fatigue exposure.

response_record.title: Performance Deviation Record
response_record.summary: A worker has made two unusual procedural errors within a short period.
details: Repeated atypical errors can be an operational sign that attention or performance is degrading.
The errors occurred during an extended night shift where fatigue is already a credible contributing factor.
The worker's current task demands and fitness for continued safety-critical work require immediate review.

closeout_record.title: Fatigue-Sensitive Handover Record
closeout_record.summary: The extended shift is ending with several tasks still partially complete.
details: Incomplete work can create hidden hazards if isolation, equipment status or remaining steps are not transferred clearly.
The incoming shift needs an accurate account of what is complete, what remains open and which controls are still in force.
A structured handover reduces the need for fatigued workers to continue solely to achieve task completion.

prejob_decision_defensible.observable: The situation is partly controlled, but a remaining gap requires recovery.
prejob_decision_defensible.guidedInsight: A partial control is not equivalent to completing every prerequisite.

prejob_decision_best.observable: The work remains controlled and the next stage is approached with the required safeguards verified.
prejob_decision_best.guidedInsight: Verify the complete control sequence before work continues.

prejob_decision_weak.observable: The control gap increases exposure and weakens the work position.
prejob_decision_weak.guidedInsight: Schedule pressure should not replace verification.

prejob_decision_critical.observable: The decision creates a serious loss of control.
prejob_decision_critical.guidedInsight: Do not substitute assumptions for verified control.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
